linkedin:
Outgrown the spreadsheet, but not ready for a heavy PMO?

That is exactly who TRACE is built for: owner-led teams in the middle. Too big to run on memory and sticky notes. Too lean to staff a project office.

If that is you, it lands. If it is not, we will tell you straight.

The fastest way to find out: the free Operations Audit Workbook walks you through your own operation and shows you the gaps.

Get it at tracestrategies.com.
